- Find the first occurrence of color `6` when scanning top-to-bottom, left-to-right.
- Clear the entire grid.
- Draw a 3×3 block centered on that `6`, using color `2` for all valid in-bounds surrounding cells.
- Preserve the center as `6`.
- If the 3×3 block reaches an edge, only draw the in-bounds portion.
